verdict.rationale: Wave's own pages list migration and onboarding help when switching from other accounting software such as FreshBooks, apparently through its Wave Advisors offering. Nothing says historical transactions carry over with full detail, or what the migration scope is. Payroll-data migration is a different story and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented preservation of historical transaction-level detail, a self-serve import tool or supported source formats/systems beyond FreshBooks, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
